# The Body Blueprint

> > Engineering muscle, mechanics & mindset through compound movements, progressive overload, and science-backed training protocols—without influencer fluff.

The Body Blueprint is a strength training and muscle-building resource created by Eugene Thong (CSCS) and Charles Damiano (B.S. Clinical Nutrition). The site focuses on biomechanically sound exercise form, hypertrophy protocols, PPL splits, and evidence-based nutrition including omega-3 supplementation.

## Key Topics

- Eugene Thong, CSCS
- Charles Damiano
- Progressive Overload
- Compound Exercises
- PPL (Push/Pull/Legs)
- Core Stability
- Hypertrophy Training
- EPA & DHA (Omega-3)
- Powerlifting
- Exercise Form & Mechanics
- Bodyweight Training
- Anti-Rotation Core Work
- Pallof Press
- CNS (Central Nervous System)
- Golden Era Training Methods

## Training Programs & Core Guides

- [The Body Blueprint: Build Muscle & Burn Fat](https://thebodyblueprint.com): Homepage: Engineering muscle, mechanics & mindset without influencer fluff
- [Training Programs: Hypertrophy, Strength & Volume Logic](https://thebodyblueprint.com/training): Main training hub covering PPL splits, progressive overload & volume logic
- [Strength Training: Powerlifting & Absolute Strength Programs](https://thebodyblueprint.com/training/build-strength): Powerlifting programs covering grip strength, deadlifts & isometric training
- [Exercise Guides: How to Perform Exercises (Form & Mechanics)](https://thebodyblueprint.com/exercises): Main exercise hub: form guides from Banded Face Pull to Weighted Pullups
- [Strength Training for Beginners: Rewriting Your Body's Code](https://thebodyblueprint.com/strength-training-beginners-guide): Beginner strength guide by Eugene Thong CSCS & Charles Damiano
- [Beginner's Resistance Training Guide: Science-Backed Workouts, Form, and Gains](https://thebodyblueprint.com/beginners-resistance-training-guide): Beginner resistance training: progressive overload, splits & Schoenfeld protocols
- [Best Workout Routines for Men: 2026 Strength & Muscle Guide](https://thebodyblueprint.com/best-workout-routines-for-men): 2026 guide to PPL splits, full-body training & Vince Gironda Golden Era methods

## Specific Exercise Tutorials

- [Dumbbell Overhead Shrug Guide: Trap Growth & Stability](https://thebodyblueprint.com/shrugoverheaddumbbells): Overhead shrug tutorial by Eugene Thong CSCS: upper trap & scapular stability
- [Single-Leg Iso Pushup: The 2026 Guide to Unilateral Chest Power](https://thebodyblueprint.com/pushup-single-leg-iso): Single-leg iso pushup tutorial: anti-rotational stability & unilateral chest work
